courses.summary: 傑伊漢是 BTC 原油運輸鏈的海運端點；課程將長管線來油、儲槽與批次裝船分成各自的量測邊界。本課依序分析管線連續來油與批次出貨、批次品質代表性、庫存變化與帳差、終端短管線壓降、船期中斷的緩衝，每項都包含可重算模型、證據規劃、故障辨析與驗收成果。數字全部是教學假設；不宣稱本案例採用這些設備參數。
courses.summaryEn: Ceyhan is the marine endpoint of the BTC crude chain; the case separates pipeline receipts, tank inventory and batch loading boundaries. The course analyses continuous receipt versus batch export, representativeness of batch quality, inventory changes and balance residuals, pressure loss in terminal piping, buffering vessel-schedule disruption, with recalculable models, evidence plans, fault discrimination and acceptance artifacts. All numbers are teaching assumptions; no plant-specific parameter is asserted.
